name: OpenClaw Voice Bridge
description: Receives WAV audio paths from snarling, transcribes via OpenAI, and injects the transcript into the agent session. Snarling owns recording; this plugin owns transcription and delivery.

debugEnabled.description: Enable debug logging to debugLogPath (default: false)

apiKey.description: Optional OpenAI API key fallback, used when the OpenClaw auth runtime cannot resolve one. Leave empty to use the auth runtime only.
